hooks.command: bash -c 'AGENT_ROLE="${CLAUDE_AGENT_ROLE:-}"; FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then FILE="$(echo $TOOL_INPUT | jq -r .file_path // .path // empty 2>/dev/null)"; fi; if [ -z "$FILE" ] || [ -z "$AGENT_ROLE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$AGENT_ROLE" in backend-dev) case "$FILE" in */MyRecipeApp/*|*/.github/*|*/CLAUDE.md) echo "BOUNDARY VIOLATION: backend-dev agent cannot modify $FILE" >&2; exit 1;; esac;; frontend-dev) case "$FILE" in */backend/*|*/deploy.sh|*/.github/*|*/CLAUDE.md) echo "BOUNDARY VIOLATION: frontend-dev agent cannot modify $FILE" >&2; exit 1;; esac;; qa-engineer) case "$FILE" in */backend/services/*|*/backend/routes/*|*/backend/config/*|*/MyRecipeApp/screens/*|*/MyRecipeApp/components/*|*/MyRecipeApp/services/*|*/MyRecipeApp/App.js) echo "BOUNDARY VIOLATION: qa-engineer agent cannot modify production code $FILE" >&2; exit 1;; esac;; reviewer|reviewer-quick) echo "BOUNDARY VIOLATION: reviewer agents cannot modify files" >&2; exit 1;; esac; exit 0'
